B=((np.arange(512)[:,None]//(2**np.arange(9)))%2).astype(float)
age=-4.2+(np.arange(144)+.5)*.05;lab=(np.arange(100)+.5)*.1
Y=np.empty((len(age),len(lab),512))
for i,a in enumerate(age):
 X=np.empty((len(lab),512,11));X[:,:,0]=a;X[:,:,1:10]=B[None,:,:];X[:,:,10]=lab[:,None]
 Y[i]=predict(X.reshape(-1,11)).reshape(len(lab),512)
mu=Y.mean();aa=Y.mean(axis=(1,2))-mu;ll=Y.mean(axis=(0,2))-mu
bb=np.array([Y[:,:,B[:,j]==1].mean()-Y[:,:,B[:,j]==0].mean() for j in range(9)])
R=Y-mu-aa[:,None,None]-ll[None,:,None]-((B-.5)@bb)[None,None,:]
for title,am,lm,bm in [
 ('old severe untreated',age>=2,lab>=0,(B[:,1]==1)&(B[:,6]==0)),
 ('old severe untreated highlab',age>=2,lab>=7,(B[:,1]==1)&(B[:,6]==0)),
 ('young mild treated',age<=-3,lab>=0,(B[:,1]==0)&(B[:,6]==1)),
 ('old severe untreated lab3plus',age>=2,lab>=3,(B[:,1]==1)&(B[:,6]==0)),
 ('old severe treated lowlab',age>=2,lab<=3,(B[:,1]==1)&(B[:,6]==1)),
 ('old mild untreated lowlab',age>=2,lab<=3,(B[:,1]==0)&(B[:,6]==0))]:
 V=R[am][:,lm][:,:,bm]; YY=Y[am][:,lm][:,:,bm]
 print(title,'mean_residual',float(V.mean()),'share_same_sign',float(np.mean(V*np.sign(V.mean())>0)),'mean_logit',float(YY.mean()),'mean_baseline_logit',float((YY-V).mean()))
print('main effects SD',float(R.std()),'explained fraction',1-float(R.var()/Y.var()))
